name: Taojia Shaonü ~Mili yu Chocolate~
original_name: 逃家少女〜蜜梨與巧克力〜
source:
On my usual way home, in the corner of the street, You found a kitten waiting for adoption... but not only! There was a girl?

The reason behind her running away home appears to be more than just a whim. What follows is a heart-pounding cohabitation, and a gradual unveiling of the girl’s mysterious background. The once quiet and ordinary life takes a dramatic turn.

Where will this forced cohabitation, and the "dream", ultimately lead?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295720/]Steam[/url]]
